BiblicalUsage: When Scripture says gᵉmûwlâh, it means dealing, recompense. The word appears 3 times, and in 2 Samuel, Isaiah, and Jeremiah it carries that same straightforward meaning. Nothing hidden sits behind it; the sense is the one you would expect from the word itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gᵉmûwlâh matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. My position is simple: I take God at His word here, and I build on that.
